title.zh: 武器战 10-30 级加点指南（演示）

description.zh: 分等级说明武器战升级加点顺序与核心天赋作用。
description.en: Level-by-level Arms warrior talent order and what the key talents do.

body.zh: 优先强化打击保证单体伤害，辅以坚韧体魄减少坐地板时间；20 级后补齐横扫、致死打击与战意，形成稳定的打怪循环。
body.en: Max Improved Strike for single-target damage and take Toughened to reduce downtime. After level 20, round out Sweep, Mortal Strike and Battle Fury for a steady kill rotation.

heading.en: Where it works - and where it does not

body.zh: 适合单人任务升级；不足是群体伤害有限、对装备有一定依赖。该方案为演示数据，仅供流程演示，不构成强度承诺。
body.en: Suited to solo questing. Weaknesses: limited multi-target damage and some gear dependence. This is demo data shown for illustration - no performance claims are made.

provenance.source: Demo fixture authored for tooling development
provenance.notes: Demo guide; must be rewritten against verified data before launch.
